title: γάρ, οὖν, and inference
subtitle: Show how a writer gives grounds and draws conclusions.
overview: γάρ typically supplies a reason, explanation, or ground; οὖν commonly marks an inference, consequence, or next narrative step. Their precise English wording changes with context.
Read at least one clause before and after the particle. A connector relates units; it cannot be interpreted in isolation.

items.grc: ἀγαπῶμεν, ὅτι αὐτὸς πρῶτος ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς.
items.en: Let us love, because he first loved us.

items.grc: οὖν οὐκέτι εἰσὶν δύο ἀλλὰ σὰρξ μία.
items.en: Therefore they are no longer two but one flesh.
